arguments.argument: View and purchase counts per product, with a store-wide abandon rate (not a per-visitor funnel — a guest who never logs in can't be matched between a view and a purchase). Views only cover the last few days by design (see Stores → Configuration → Ordo Automation for the on-site tracking retention window) and are counted incrementally, so a brand-new view may take up to 30 minutes to appear here.
